remarks: Welcome to 50 Glenbrook Road #1F, a move-in ready 1-bedroom condominium in a convenient Stamford location. This bright and inviting unit offers a spacious layout with generously sized rooms, an updated feel, and abundant natural light throughout. The well-appointed kitchen provides ample cabinet space and opens to a comfortable dining area, while the living space is perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy the ease of main-level living close to shopping, restaurants, public transportation, and everything Stamford has to offer. A wonderful opportunity for homeowners or investors alike.
